note: Music bed for the Wolverine analysis sample. Bryce, 2026-11-12: 'epic cinematic orchestra like the soundtrack of games / movies'; picked Last Dawn (theme), Epic and Dramatic Trailer Music (tension) and Red (tender, read as track 3 of the audition). Red is Jean's theme: her 1800s story, the garden and the fairy tale. Never the game's own soundtrack. Sections start at a beat; offset is seconds into the track; gain_db is the bed level under narration (the track is first normalised to -16 LUFS, the same as the voice). 2026-11-13 (v6): whole bed 4 dB lower so it sits at least 18 dB under the voice (v5 review found 12-14 dB in six paragraphs; Bryce asked for an audible narrator).
tracks_note: B2 keys in the private bucket (licensed tracks stay out of the public repo, 2026-11-12).
